source.section: Note 17. Shareholders' Equity · Common Stock Repurchase Plan
source.quote: During the three months ended June 30, 2026, we repurchased 0.5 million shares under the Program for a total cost of $74.9 million
In February and April 2026, our Board of Directors declared $0.339 per share quarterly dividends, which were paid to shareholders in March and May 2026.
In the second quarter and first half of 2026, higher freight, raw material and energy costs negatively impacted operating income by $4 million and $6 million, respectively
